description: May 18 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 3, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 18 birthday falls in Taurus, in the third decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: The May 18 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Near the end of Taurus season, the 18th of May mixes Saturn's maturity with the wide-hearted number 9. Twenty-seven degrees into the sign, the Bull's attachment to possessions loosens slightly, and the question becomes what to pass on. Interpretive traditions describe a giver of practical help, the friend who lends tools, teaches skills and quietly leaves things better than found.

Astronomically, May 18 puts the Sun near 27° Taurus in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Saturn. The closing decan of Taurus answers to Saturn, ruler of Capricorn, and this lends the sign's earthiness a long-range, structural quality. Instead of only enjoying what is solid, mid-May natives are often drawn to building it: savings, institutions, skills that compound over decades. Astrologers tend to call them serious, reliable and quietly ambitious, with a dry humour that surfaces once trust is established. Saturn can also bring a heavier sense of duty and a habit of postponing pleasure until some imagined finish line. Remembering that Taurus is a Venus sign first can help, because rest and beauty belong inside the structure too.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for May 18
paragraphs: A birthday on the 18th reduces as 1 + 8 = 9, so the birthday number is 9. The compound pairs the 1's leadership with the 8's capacity to organise and manage, then turns both towards the 9's humanitarian outlook. Eighteenth-born people are often described as able to make a real difference: they can organise a fundraiser, run a team or argue a cause convincingly. Emotional openness may sometimes lag behind their practical help. This secondary number tends to suit those who use their influence for others rather than for status, and who measure success by what it changes.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a May 18 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous May 18 birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 18 is the 138th day of the year (139th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Gemini, is usually complete within 3 days, by May 21.

By May 18 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a May 18 birthday are John Paul II (1920), Bertrand Russell (1872) and Nicholas II of Russia (1868).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 18?
faq.answer: May 18 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 18?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 18 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 18th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 18?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 18, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 18?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on May 18 include John Paul II (1920), Bertrand Russell (1872) and Nicholas II of Russia (1868). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
